question: Without changing any P6N parameter, does its full-collimation synthetic RGB Q envelope cover both reported and directly recomputed silver-sample Q values while preserving the dye-material negative control?

evaluation.model_envelope: minimum and maximum of the unchanged P6N red, green and blue Q values at each measured silver diffuse density
evaluation.measurement_values: evaluate reported_q and raw directed_density/diffuse_density separately; neither may replace the other

allowed_after_pass: retain P6N as a quantitatively compatible generic Callier amplitude control
open one separately frozen photographic nuisance-value pilot without stock or scanner claims
forbidden: change P6N peak density, Q increment, wavelength weights or collimation
choose one RGB channel after seeing measurements
replace reported Q with raw ratios or hide their discrepancy
fit a curve to four samples
infer stock, process, scanner or illuminant metadata

branch_rule.pass: Retain fixed P6N as a quantitatively compatible generic amplitude control; no calibration claim.
branch_rule.fail: Close fixed P6N quantitative compatibility without parameter rescue, retain only its synthetic primitive evidence, and continue another ready physical or colour leaf.

claim_ceiling: Fixed synthetic P6N compatibility against four homogeneous-sample measurements from one thesis experiment; not a fitted curve, population result, stock/process/scanner calibration or product profile.
